item.title: Coherent Control of Thermal Transport with Pillar-Based Phononic Crystals
item.description:
Communications Physics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s42005-026-02774-6

Korkiamäki et al. measure the thermal conductance of nano- and microscale pillared phononic crystals at sub-Kelvin temperatures. They demonstrate up to an order of magnitude reduction, attributed to the coherent modification of the phononic band structure.
